smartMotor: Control the Smart Motor Extension Kit through I2C.
smartMotor.TurnDirection: Clockwise or counterclockwise direction for relative motor motion.
smartMotor.TurnDirectionEx: Direction selection for absolute-angle motor motion.
smartMotor.TurnMode: Seconds, degrees, or turns used by relative motor motion.
smartMotor.DriveDirection: Forward or backward robot travel direction.
smartMotor.DriveMode: Seconds, millimeters, or centimeters used by straight robot travel.
smartMotor.WaitMode: Whether a block returns immediately or waits for fresh motor feedback to indicate completion.
smartMotor.SensorAxis: Axis used for onboard gyroscope and acceleration data.
smartMotor.motorStart: Start one motor at the selected speed and direction.
smartMotor.motorStop: Stop one motor with the highest-priority stop command.
smartMotor.motorReset: Reset the physical position stored inside one motor and optionally wait for confirmation.
smartMotor.motorMoveRelative: Move one motor by seconds, degrees, or turns and optionally wait for feedback-based completion.
smartMotor.motorMoveAbsolute: Move one motor to a single-turn absolute angle and optionally wait for feedback-based completion.
smartMotor.motorGetSpeed: Refresh and read the motor speed in degrees per second.
smartMotor.motorGetRelativeAngle: Refresh and read the motor angle relative to the physical or controller-side zero.
smartMotor.motorGetAbsoluteAngle: Refresh and read the normalized single-turn motor angle from 0 to 359.9 degrees.
smartMotor.robotSetWheelDiameter: Set the wheel diameter in millimeters for straight-distance conversion.
smartMotor.robotSetMotors: Select the left and right motors used by robot blocks.
smartMotor.robotMove: Set independent signed speeds for the left and right wheels with one I2C command.
smartMotor.robotTurnTo: Turn the robot by a relative angle using onboard yaw feedback without PID control.
smartMotor.robotDriveStraight: Drive both wheels for a requested time or distance with one command.
smartMotor.robotStop: Cancel active robot turning and stop both selected wheels.
smartMotor.robotGetYaw: Read the onboard Z-axis accumulated yaw angle used by robot turning.
smartMotor.readGyroAngle: Read one onboard gyroscope accumulated angle in degrees.
smartMotor.readAcceleration: Read one onboard accelerometer axis in milligravity.
